description: Search the full text of federal law: United States Code, Code of Federal Regulations, Public Laws, Congressional Bills, Executive Orders. Results are ranked across every corpus unless `corpus` narrows them, each with its citation, a link and the matching words. A query that is only a citation returns that document instead.

date.description: For a code, search it as it stood on this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

page.description: Page of results, 20 to a page.

query.description: Words, a "quoted phrase", NOT before a word to exclude it, or a citation.

title.description: For a code, search one title ("11", "40").

name: search
